subject: CAIQ claim verification sprint — control traceback & artifact handoff
messages:
From: Amir Hassan <amir.h@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ clarifications — traceability for scoped controls

Sean / Redwood team,

Thanks for the initial CAIQ package. Our security review flagged a small set of controls where we need clearer traceability from claim -> control -> artifact. To avoid multiple back-and-forths, can we run a short "claim verification" sprint focused on the following controls (examples):

- CMAF-01 / CSA-IA-01 (Tenant isolation / logical segregation): design diagram + configuration snippets + deployment manifest
- LOG-07 / CSA-NT-11 (Operational logging & retention): log samples showing retention & redact rules, ingestion pipeline notes
- ENC-02 / CSA-KM-04 (Key management): KMS/HSM attestation & rotation schedule evidence
- ACC-05 / CSA-ID-03 (Privileged access): admin roster export, privileged access workflow

Deliverables we'd like to see for each control: brief rationale mapping line, the artifact filename(s), & one sample snippet we can open for verification. If needed we can accept redacted samples for PII.

Timeline: we need a consolidated package and brief joint review by 2027-05-06 to keep our procurement calendar. Please confirm feasibility and an initial owner contact.

Best,
Amir Hassan
Security Review Lead — Nimbus Health
amir.h@nimbushealth.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Amir Hassan <amir.h@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ clarifications — traceability for scoped controls

Hi Amir — thanks for the clear list. We can run a focused claim verification sprint and aim to deliver a consolidated artifact bundle for your review by 2027-05-05 (giving you a day to review before 05-06).

What we'll deliver: a single zip (artifact_bundle_nimbus_20270430.zip) containing a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (caiq_control_claims_mapping_v1.xlsx), a short README (claim_verification_readme.md) describing each artifact, redacted log samples (kv_log_samples.tar.gz), tenant isolation diagram (tenant_isolation_design.pdf), and a KMS attestation extract.

Proposed approach / next steps:
- We run an internal sprint to collate artifacts (deadline: 2027-05-03 EOD PT).
- Share the bundle with you and schedule a 30-min walkthrough the week of 2027-05-04.
- If you need additional deep-dive evidence after the walkthrough, we can open a scoped follow-up with access controls.

Please confirm the controls you listed above are the right scope. If yes, I'll assign internal owners and start artifact collection immediately. Also: do you prefer the artifacts on a secure drive link or staged in an SFTP drop?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ clarifications — actions and artifact owners (Sprint)

Team — forwarding Nimbus' ask. We're on a short window; assign and confirm below: 

Kimberly — owner for tenant isolation (CMAF-01). Please prepare: tenant_isolation_design.pdf, network ACL export, and a short config snippet showing vNet/NSG separation. Target: upload to our secure drive by 2027-05-03 5pm PT.

Marissa — owner for operational logging (LOG-07). Provide: redact-friendly log samples (kv_log_samples.tar.gz), retention policy excerpt, and ingestion diagram. Make sure sample includes timestamp rollover + retention tag. Target: 2027-05-03 5pm PT.

Jonas — owner for KMS/key management (ENC-02). Provide: KMS attestation extract (redacted), key rotation schedule excerpt, access policy snippet. If we need an HSM letter, coordinate with infra and include contact. Target: 2027-05-03 5pm PT.

Notes / constraints: avoid full PII in samples; prefer redact/replace. We will bundle everything into artifact_bundle_nimbus_20270430.zip and include caiq_control_claims_mapping_v1.xlsx that maps each CAIQ question -> our claim -> artifact filename -> one-line evidence summary.

Confirm you can meet the deadlines and reply with any blockers. I will prepare the README and a short walkthrough deck for the 30-min review.

— Sean
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Amir Hassan <amir.h@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, SecureAudit <audit@secureaudit.io>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: CAIQ claim verification — artifact bundle & walkthrough scheduling

Amir — attaching the consolidated bundle as discussed. Summary below and attachments are available on the secure drive link in case the zip is large.

Attachments in artifact_bundle_nimbus_20270430.zip:
- caiq_control_claims_mapping_v1.xlsx  (mapping: CAIQ question -> Redwood claim -> artifact filename -> short evidence snippet)
- claim_verification_readme.md (how to interpret samples + redaction notes)
- tenant_isolation_design.pdf (diagram + config snippet)
- kv_log_samples.tar.gz (redacted log slices, retention markers included)
- kms_attestation_excerpt.pdf (redacted)

Controls addressed (high level):
- CMAF-01 / Tenant isolation: tenant_isolation_design.pdf, network ACL export
- LOG-07 / Operational logging: kv_log_samples.tar.gz, ingestion pipeline excerpt
- ENC-02 / Key management: kms_attestation_excerpt.pdf, rotation schedule snippet
- ACC-05 / Privileged access: admin-roster.csv (redacted) included in bundle

Proposed walkthrough times (30m):
- Wed 2027-05-05 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2027-05-05 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, propose alternatives. SecureAudit (cc'd) can join to validate our mapping if Nimbus would like a third-party witness.

Please reply with preferred slot and any immediate clarifying questions. If you accept the bundle as-is, indicate which controls (if any) need deeper artifacts and we'll scope follow-up.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
